name: Hetalia NEXT Academy
source:
"Honda Momo, a rather reserved student at World Academy W, is chosen to be the representative of Asian class for the school's annual party. Having to plan for the event, she get to meet and understand different kinds of people; something she never experienced before. Along the way, would she finally meet the childhood friend from her memory?"

A simple visual novel game sets in a rather distant future from the current Hetalia timeline; somewhat Human!AU where the Hetalia characters have their own family and children. The story focused on the life of thus Second Generations of Hetalia at the World Academy W.

[from DeviantArt]
translation:
“Wonda Momo，一个性格内向的W学院学生，被选为学校年会的亚洲班代表。在筹划这次活动的过程中，她接触、了解了不同类型的人，这是她从未经历过的。一路走来，她最终会遇到记忆中的童年好友吗？”

一款简单的视觉小说游戏，背景设定在距离当前黑塔利亚时间线相当遥远的未来；有点人类！黑塔利亚角色有自己的家庭和孩子的AU。故事围绕黑塔利亚第二代在W世界学院的生活展开。

[来自异常艺术]
